reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Turn an unbounded game idea into a short falsifiable product contract that fixes the player action, repeatable loop, session shape, progression, differentiator, exclusions, and observable acceptance conditions before implementation.
neutralIntentExamples: define a testable game brief before implementation begins
turn a broad game concept into explicit actions, loops, anti-goals, and acceptance evidence
inputs: game concept, audience, platform, session shape, and business model
operations: resolve the core player action, loop, failure, progression, differentiation, anti-goals, and stranger-checkable outcomes
outputs: compact game contract with explicit unknowns and measurable acceptance criteria
failureBehavior: halt code production when foundational fields remain unresolved and expose deliberate divergence instead of rewriting the brief after the fact
exclusions: subjective fun claims presented as deterministic tests
usefulInvariants: the final build is compared against the declared contract
materialRisks: a one-page format may hide complex production constraints
premature certainty can fossilize a weak concept

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Represent narrative truth, temporal validity, audience knowledge, contradiction classes, and leak surfaces as inspectable evidence so authored and generated storytelling remains coherent without granting probabilistic judgments authority over canon.
neutralIntentExamples: design a queryable canon and revelation system for a game world
audit narrative contradictions and spoiler leaks across game and publishing surfaces
inputs: world facts, timelines, scenes, character knowledge, reveal state, and publishing surfaces
operations: separate truth from audience revelation, track temporal assertions, classify contradictions, audit leaks, and require human acceptance for canon proposals
outputs: source-linked narrative ledgers, contradiction evidence, leak controls, and bounded human review queues
failureBehavior: fail deterministic contradictions, label uncertain model findings as suggestions, and prevent unrevealed information from entering player-facing outputs
exclusions: prose as the sole source of narrative truth
automated soft judgments promoted to hard failures
usefulInvariants: truth and audience knowledge remain distinct
every hidden fact must have a player-observable consequence
materialRisks: overly rigid contradiction rules can suppress intentional ambiguity
localization and generated dialogue create indirect leak paths

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Design and inspect a declared game economy around transparent value exchange, authoritative transaction handling, restorative purchase behavior, and measurements that expose both commercial health and player harm.
neutralIntentExamples: design an honest premium or free-to-play economy with explicit boundaries
audit purchase grants, currency authority, refund signals, and coercive monetization risks
inputs: business model, currencies, offers, competitive surfaces, transaction flow, and player outcome evidence
operations: separate earned and purchased value, reject coercive mechanics, specify authoritative receipt validation, and measure conversion alongside refunds and sentiment
outputs: economy contract, transaction safeguards, refusal decisions, and evidence-driven tuning questions
failureBehavior: refuse deceptive or exploitative mechanics and defer legal, platform, price, and production transaction changes to current authority
usefulInvariants: commercial metrics never erase harm indicators
materialRisks: economy tuning can drift into manipulation
